evidence_summary: Altaba states Yahoo common stock traded as YHOO through 2017-06-16 and AABA began 2017-06-19.
Consolidated Stores common stock was NYSE CNS before the 2001 Big Lots name change.
Big Lots announced the 2001-05-16 name/ticker change to BLI; later SEC-filed company remarks state BLI changed to BIG effective 2006-08-18.
Computer Sciences Corporation common stock traded NYSE as CSC; DXC did not exist until the 2017 CSC/HPE Enterprise Services combination.
Sun Microsystems states its stock traded as SUNW prior to 2007-08-27, then JAVA.
Exchange notice states Citizens Communications CZN changed to Frontier Communications FTR effective 2008-07-31.
Anthem common stock traded NYSE as ATH before the 2004 merger.
After Anthem/WellPoint merger, surviving Anthem parent was renamed WellPoint and began trading as WLP on 2004-12-01; later renamed Anthem in December 2014.
Baker Hughes common stock traded through 2017-07-03 before BHGE Class A began trading 2017-07-05.
Fortune Brands traded NYSE as FO before the separation that left the spirits company to be renamed Beam and trade as BEAM.
BB&T was the surviving corporation in the SunTrust merger, renamed Truist, with ticker changed to TFC; candidate is admitted only if frozen SEP stores historical BB&T sessions under TFC.
